json.title: Endless Coast Summer
json.logline: A golden memory of a summer drive to the sea where time felt unhurried and endless.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Felt piano notes begin as a young woman appears by a car on a coastal road.
Warm pad swells as the hand reaches into the golden air.
Brushed percussion enters as coastal grasses sway in sea breeze.
String swell peaks on the young woman looking toward the ocean cliff.
Euphoric arpeggio and sub bass trigger a flash to a wide cliffside vista.
Dip to white transitions into memory collage layers.
Final warm piano chord decays as dusk shadows blanket the quiet sea.

scenes.camera_note: Slow framing push toward the subject standing on the coastal road.
scenes.action: A young woman in a green jacket over a dark sweater stands beside a classic station wagon on a dusty coastal road at dusk.
scenes.setting: Narrow asphalt coastal road beside a cliff face under low golden sunset light.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle horizontal drift following the car contour with background sea haze.
scenes.action: A hand reaches out of a moving vintage car window into the golden air.
scenes.setting: Coastal highway with sea mist and sun-bleached terracotta cliffs in the distance.

scenes.camera_note: Low angle tilt rising from grass blades to the horizon.
scenes.action: Tall golden coastal grass sways under a warm sea wind.
scenes.setting: Grassy sand dune overlooking distant ocean waves and sage green foliage.

scenes.camera_note: Tight slow push to three-quarter profile face with backlighting.
scenes.action: The young woman turns her face toward the setting sun on a high headland cliff.
scenes.setting: Edge of a headland cliff overlooking sparkling sea water with amber highlights.

scenes.camera_note: Wide expansive pull out revealing the endless ocean expanse behind her.
scenes.action: The young woman opens her arms toward the expansive ocean under a golden sunset sky.
scenes.setting: Panoramic ocean vista atop high headland peak with warm rose clouds.

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane drift combining close detail cutouts and landscape brushwork.
scenes.action: Fragments of ocean surf, dusty vehicle trim, and dried wildflowers overlap in a painterly montage.
scenes.setting: Layered memory space blending sea foam textures and golden evening light.

scenes.camera_note: Slow receding pull letting deep shadows envelope the static scene.
scenes.action: The young woman leans quietly against the vehicle bonnet as dusk shadows settle.
scenes.setting: Quiet coastal lookout point with deep blue-violet shadows and fading sky light.
